summary: 1606 Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a second amendment to a purchase and sale agreement for real property in Texas. The amendment extends the closing date from May 22, 2026 to October 31, 2026, with the purchase price unchanged at $11,168,864. The company will pay a $312,000 extension fee, partly creditable to the purchase price. The filing discloses a routine contract modification, not a transformative corporate event. There is no change in control, acquisition target change, or special situation. The transaction remains pending with a conditional automatic termination provision tied to tax litigation resolution.
